caption: The drawing features two doll-like figures positioned side by side against a plain, cream-colored background. The figure on the left has a tan, wooden-like appearance with geometric patterns on its torso, long black hair, and a necklace made of blue and white beads. This figure has striped legs, round eyes, and a mouth outlined on its face, and it is dressed in a simple red cloth skirt. The figure on the right is rendered with a more abstract form, also with long black hair, a face painted with yellow and red colors, and a necklace with blue beads. Its upper body appears to be covered in a blotchy-patterned garment with shades of green, yellow, and red, while its lower half is wrapped in a red skirt with an additional white fabric featuring circular designs. Both figures have visible details marked by subtle shadows and highlights, and there are pencil annotations and small rectangular patches or marks in the corners of the drawing. The drawing includes the artist's signature and a date at the bottom right.
title: Clay Indian Dolls
